major: Added secure in-app updates with download progress, SHA-256 verification, safe executable replacement, rollback, and automatic relaunch
features: Added a bundled changelog covering every Kumori release with major, feature, improvement, and fix groups
Added Changelog actions above Discord in the main navigation and inside Settings & tools
The latest changelog now opens automatically after Kumori successfully installs an update
improvements: Available updates now appear as an in-app prompt as well as a tray notification
The changelog is maintained in the repository and remains available without an internet connection
Settings & tools is less cluttered with grouped maintenance, folder, and replay-diagnostic actions plus a separated bottom developer area
Developer capture, recovery-test, log-retention, and cache-activity controls now live on a dedicated Developer settings page
Recent stable and lazer replay recoveries made with an older simulation schema are upgraded automatically once
fixes: Fixed Settings crashing while loading changelog information
Fixed the Launch tosu action repeatedly appearing and disappearing when the tracker connection briefly changes
Corrected replay-recovered accuracy using official simulated score statistics
Restored exact miss, 100, 50, and slider-break events to the map-pressure graph after replay recovery
Added updater timeout handling, staged-download verification, failure reporting, and restoration of the previous executable

major: Replay comparison now overlays a second compatible replay with independently coloured skin cursor, trail, judgement markers, playback controls, and score statistics
Custom themes now provide live in-app colour editing, previews, import, and export
features: Added temporary checksum-validated .osr comparison without saving imported replay data to history
Added replay-result recovery when tosu gameplay values are unavailable, including accelerated lazer simulation, PP, difficulty, timing, and rich judgement recovery
Added database backups and staged restore, a built-in Argon Pro fallback skin, developer recovery testing, and cache-addition diagnostics
improvements: Kumori now reads osu!lazer Realm resources directly where possible and avoids unnecessary local cache copies
Replay comparison eligibility now matches gameplay-altering speed, geometry, layout, target-motion, and difficulty-adjustment mods while ignoring visibility-only mods
Replay comparison, analyzer menus, dashboard sizing, maximized-window bounds, colour picking, and selected-play artwork were refined for readability and responsiveness
Logs and cache-addition records now share configurable age and size rotation
fixes: Prevented watched local, other-player, and autoplay replays from being recorded as new plays
Fixed backup database locking and themed backup presentation
Fixed replay comparison crashes, dark recolours, uneven trails, clipped cards, stale menus, and invalid .osr file-picker marshaling
Fixed missing or deleted replay skins continuing to override the built-in fallback

features: Published the refreshed Kumori desktop experience with stable and lazer replay support

major: Added osu!stable replay capture and recovery alongside osu!lazer

osu!lazer media is resolved directly from Realm-backed resources instead of being duplicated into Kumori cache
fixes: Suppressed watched replay and autoplay sessions so they are not added to play history

features: Added .osr replay validation against the selected play and beatmap
improvements: Expanded tosu diagnostics, replay resilience, companion controls, launch handling, and tracking fallbacks
fixes: Fixed PP telemetry, session playtime, and tosu restart after display-mode osu! relaunches

features: Added replay attempt trends, timing insights, and original beatmap star display
improvements: Expanded analyzer overlays, partial playback, event inspection, miss evidence, and navigation controls

fixes: Corrected Kumori release-page URLs used by update checks

Applied the tracked osu! replay-viewer compatibility patch
Handled an empty osu!lazer dependency checkout during replay-viewer bootstrap
